purpose: Deflated Sharpe ratio and CSCV probability of backtest overfitting over the retained multi-candidate research-evaluation ledger. Diagnostic only; no selection, tuning or promotion follows from the result.

source.provenance: Byte-identical regeneration of the private run-1 ledger whose SHA-256 the research-evaluation receipt records; the regeneration comparison is the gap-wave2 portfolio-risk raw/3 compare.json.

series.segment: development only: observed labels whose decision date is on or before 2020-12-31; reserved 2021Q1 labels are excluded
series.value: net_proxy (five-session open-to-open raw-price label less the fixed 20bp cost proxy), parsed from its decimal string
series.deduplication: One value per (candidate, decision). Training and evaluation copies of the same episode must be identical; any conflict is an error.
series.alignment: Every trial must have an observed value at every retained decision date; otherwise an error.

dsr.sharpe: Per-episode (five-session) mean divided by population standard deviation; not annualized. A zero-variance series with zero mean (cash) has Sharpe 0.
dsr.moments: Population skewness and non-excess kurtosis of the selected trial's series (Bailey and Lopez de Prado 2014 gamma3, gamma4).
dsr.selected_trial: Highest full-development Sharpe within the trial set; ties by trial-set order.
dsr.trial_count: Number of trials in the set (no effective-N clustering).
dsr.trial_variance: Sample variance (ddof=1) of the trial Sharpe estimates.
dsr.benchmark: Expected maximum Sharpe under the null, SR0 = sqrt(V) * ((1-gamma) * Phi^-1(1-1/N) + gamma * Phi^-1(1-1/(N e))).

pbo.method: CSCV (Bailey, Borwein, Lopez de Prado and Zhu 2017)
pbo.truncation: Drop the earliest T mod S rows so that S contiguous blocks have equal size.
pbo.in_sample_tie_break: Trial-set order (the frozen plan's tie rule).
pbo.out_of_sample_rank: Ascending rank among the N trials with average ranks for ties; omega = rank / (N + 1); lambda = ln(omega / (1 - omega)).
pbo.pbo_rule: Share of combinations with lambda <= 0 (primary). The strict lambda < 0 share and the count of lambda == 0 are reported alongside.

walk_forward.series: Development evaluation labels of each development fold's frozen chosen candidate (from the research-evaluation receipt), observed only.
walk_forward.statistic: Probabilistic Sharpe ratio against a zero benchmark; the walk-forward selector is one pre-registered procedure, so no additional trial deflation is applied to it.
